attempts.summary: Set up centralized log collection: node2 runs a new 'inventory' systemd service (logger -t inventory, facility local0.info) whose messages are forwarded via rsyslog omfwd over TCP port 601 with a disk-assisted queue (unlimited retry, saveOnShutdown) to node1. node1 listens via imtcp on 601/tcp (firewalld port opened, SELinux syslogd_port_t-compatible reserved port) and filters incoming messages by fromhost-ip=node2 and programname=inventory into /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Both rsyslog services and inventory.service are systemd-enabled for boot persistence. Restarted node1 then node2 one at a time via native reboot, proved boot-id change on each, and verified log flow fully recovered post-restart on both nodes, including delivery of messages queued during node1's downtime.
